title: Is xdrip+ working with Libre2 and mioamioa1 or miaomiao2?
symptom: User is confused about whether xDrip+ works with Libre2 using MiaoMiao2 (patched or new) and asks for correct configuration. They always get 'No sensor has been found' using datasource 'libre wifi'.
fix: Choose 'Libre Bluetooth' in Hardware Data Source when using MiaoMiao with Libre.
evidence_quote: You should choose "Libre Bluetooth" in Hardware Data Source, if you are using MM with Libre...
